EXL also provided positive guidance for 2025, projecting revenue between $2.025 billion and $2.060 billion and adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $1.83 to $1.89, driven by strategic AI initiatives and operational enhancements.

title: Cisco Expands Partnership with NVIDIA to Accelerate AI Adoption in the Enterprise
summary: Cisco and NVIDIA announced an expanded partnership to accelerate AI adoption in enterprises by creating a cross-portfolio unified architecture for AI-ready data center networks. This collaboration will integrate Cisco Silicon One with NVIDIA Spectrum-X, making Cisco the only partner silicon included in NVIDIA Spectrum-X. The aim is to provide enterprises with flexibility and choice in AI infrastructure, simplifying deployment and optimizing performance for AI workloads.

title: Foresight integrates NVIDIA Jetson Orin into its perception technologies
summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. has integrated NVIDIA Jetson Orin computing platforms into its 3D perception technologies, expanding its focus from autonomous vehicles to uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs). This collaboration utilizes both Jetson Orin Nano and Jetson AGX Orin to enhance performance, energy efficiency, and real-time data processing for diverse applications. The integration allows Foresight's systems to deliver advanced AI and GPU capabilities for improved environmental perception in challenging conditions.

title: Sify opens AI-Hub data centre in Lucknow
summary: Sify Infinit Space launched its AI-Hub Data Centre in Lucknow to bolster northern India's data infrastructure. Located within HCL IT City, the facility will be developed in four phases, with the first phase operational by June 2025. This initiative supports Uttar Pradesh's goal of becoming a data center hub and aligns with Sify's investment strategy and their recent certification as Nvidia's co-location partner.

title: NVIDIA Earth-2 Features First Gen AI to Power Weather Super-Resolution for Continental US
summary: NVIDIA's Earth-2 platform introduces CorrDiff, a generative AI weather model that significantly enhances forecast precision for the continental U.S., down to a kilometer scale. This model, optimized to be 10,000 times more energy-efficient than traditional methods, aims to improve disaster preparedness and save lives by providing high-resolution predictions of extreme weather events. It is already being adopted by various agencies and companies globally, demonstrating its potential for applications in regional forecasting, renewable energy, and disaster management.

title: Salesforce Earnings Preview: Google Deal in Focus as Stock Slides
summary: Salesforce (CRM) is set to report quarterly earnings, with analysts expecting an EPS of $2.61 on $10.04 billion in revenue. A recent expanded partnership with Google (GOOGL) will integrate Google's Gemini AI chatbot into Salesforce's Agentforce platform, aiming to enhance AI capabilities. Despite the strategic partnership, the stock has fallen from its all-time high, and high implied volatility in options suggests significant market anticipation for the earnings report.

summary: Cadence Design Systems reported strong Q4 2024 revenues, up 27% to $1.36 billion, driven by surging demand for AI-driven chip design software and expanded partnerships with major chipmakers like Nvidia and Intel. title: NXP buys Kinara for $307M to power AI workloads at the network edge
summary: Dutch chipmaker NXP Semiconductors N.V. has acquired California-based startup Kinara Inc. for $307 million to bolster its presence in AI workloads at the network edge. summary: TeraWulf (WULF) shares dropped 15.2% following its strategic pivot from Bitcoin mining to high-performance computing (HPC), supported by Google and new private capital. This shift was announced alongside its full-year 2025 financial results, which reported significant revenue and net losses. The company's new investment narrative centers on Google's expanded $3.2 billion commitment and a $400 million private placement to fund its 3 gigawatt development pipeline for HPC, raising both growth prospects and dilution concerns for investors.

title: Vista Capital Partners Inc. Raises Holdings in Microsoft Corporation $MSFT
summary: Vista Capital Partners Inc. increased its stake in Microsoft Corporation by 5.2% in Q3, now holding 29,889 shares valued at $15.48 million. Institutional investors collectively own over 71% of Microsoft, which has an average analyst rating of "Moderate Buy" and an average target price of $591.95. Microsoft recently exceeded Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, reporting EPS of $4.14 and revenue of $81.27 billion.

title: Alphabet CEO Pichai Sundar sells $9.8 million in GOOGL stock By Investing.com
summary: Alphabet CEO Pichai Sundar recently sold $9.8 million in Class C Capital Stock, disposing of 32,500 shares in transactions ranging from $301.57 to $305.14. Despite the sale, he maintains significant direct and indirect ownership in Alphabet, with the sales executed under a pre-adopted trading plan. The article also touches upon Google's new AI model, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and other tech industry news.

title: Alphabet CEO Pichai Sundar sells $9.8 million in GOOGL stock
summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai sold $9.8 million worth of Class C Capital Stock in Alphabet Inc. through a series of transactions on March 4, 2026. The sales were made at prices between $301.57 and $305.14, and he acquired 265,001 Class C Google Stock Units with a value of $0. Following these transactions, Pichai maintains significant direct and indirect ownership in Alphabet.

title: GOOG stock heads into Monday: Alphabet closes higher as Google faces Belgium ad probe, Korea Maps decision
summary: Alphabet's Class C stock (GOOG) closed higher on Friday despite broader market declines, as Google faces a new antitrust probe in Belgium regarding its ad pricing methods. Simultaneously, South Korea approved Google’s request to export high-precision map data with strict security controls, potentially improving Google Maps functionality in the country. Investors are now watching how these regulatory and market developments will impact GOOG stock as trading resumes on Monday, especially with upcoming U.S. labor data and the Federal Reserve meeting on the horizon.

title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Stock Steady Near $311 as AI Investments Surge Post-Q4 2025 Earnings Beat
summary: Alphabet's Class A shares traded steadily near $311 after the company announced blockbuster Q4 2025 results, featuring record revenues, explosive Google Cloud acceleration, and massive AI infrastructure commitments. The tech giant's Q4 revenue reached $113.8 billion, exceeding estimates, with Google Cloud contributing $17.7 billion and achieving sustained profitability. Alphabet is heavily investing in AI, with planned 2026 capital expenditures of $175-$185 billion for data centers and custom silicon, signaling its commitment to leading in generative AI despite regulatory challenges and competitive risks.

title: GOOG stock price: Alphabet Class C rises after Wells Fargo upgrade puts AI capex back in spotlight
summary: Alphabet Class C (GOOG) shares rose by 0.3% after Wells Fargo upgraded the stock to Overweight and raised its price target to $387, citing Alphabet's strong position in AI computing. While the upgrade highlights the company's significant investment in AI infrastructure, concerns remain regarding high capital expenditures and potential impacts from new tariffs, which are clouding broader market sentiment. Investors are also looking ahead to Nvidia's earnings for further insights into AI infrastructure demand.

title: Baidu Inc: Wall Street Turns Cautious as AI Bets Face Reality Check
summary: Wall Street is increasingly cautious about Baidu Inc due to slowing growth, rising competition, and geopolitical risks, despite its status as a profitable search giant investing heavily in AI and autonomous driving. Investors are rethinking the stock's valuation, which is influenced by China's tech cycle, the global AI arms race, and US-Beijing tensions. The article highlights how Baidu functions as a leveraged bet on Chinese digitalization, offering diversification but with higher volatility and policy risk compared to US tech companies.

title: Google stock (GOOG) jumps after Supreme Court tariff ruling as traders brace for Nvidia earnings
summary: Alphabet's Class C shares (GOOG) jumped 3.7% in after-hours trading following a Supreme Court decision to toss out U.S. tariffs and new AI product announcements. The company's stock performance is also influenced by its significant capital expenditure on AI infrastructure, with investors looking to upcoming Nvidia earnings for broader AI market insights. Analysts are divided on whether current high valuations for AI-related stocks are sustainable, given the substantial investments required.

title: Is Apple (AAPL) John Overdeck's Top Pick?
summary: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is the third largest holding in John Overdeck's portfolio, representing a 2.79% share valued at $1.39 billion. While still a significant investment, it trails NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) which remains his largest position. Recent developments for Apple include plans to allow third-party AI apps in CarPlay, moving beyond Siri-only, and upcoming product releases like the iPhone 17e and an iOS 26.4 beta.

title: Elon Musk Says Tesla Will Have 'Largest Fleet' Of Autonomous Vehicles As Far Into The Future As He Can Imagine
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk stated that he expects the company to have the largest fleet of autonomous vehicles as far into the future as he can imagine. This aligns with Tesla's ongoing efforts in autonomous technology, including Robotaxi trials in Austin and investments in AI and machine learning. The article also touches upon the deepening competition in autonomous vehicles, mentioning Waymo and NVIDIA's recent advancements, and the ongoing debate surrounding liability and insurance for self-driving cars.

title: Why Is Broadcom (AVGO) Stock Soaring Today
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) stock jumped 7.6% after Wall Street acknowledged the significant revenue potential from Google’s announced AI infrastructure spending, with Broadcom securing $21 billion in orders for custom AI accelerators. This positive development led Wolfe Research to upgrade the stock to Outperform and Jefferies to reiterate its Buy rating, despite the stock experiencing volatility and recent declines due to geopolitical tensions impacting chip exports to China.

title: Fund Manager Recommends Elon Musk Buyback Tesla Shares To Spark Stock Turnaround
summary: Future Fund Managing Partner Gary Black suggests Elon Musk should buy back Tesla shares, launch a brand awareness campaign for autonomous driving, and introduce a conventional pickup truck to boost the stock. Black argues that a CEO buying back shares demonstrates confidence and that these measures are crucial given Tesla's double-digit stock drop in 2026 compared to the Nasdaq-100's single-digit decline and increasing competition in the autonomous vehicle sector. He also controversially recommends removing safety monitors from robotaxis to prove FSD's safety to skeptics.

title: Earnings call transcript: Alphabet Q4 2025 highlights strong earnings beat
summary: Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) delivered strong financial results for Q4 2025, beating analyst expectations with an EPS of $2.82 and revenue of $113.8 billion. The company saw an 18% increase in revenue year-over-year, surpassed $400 billion in annual revenue for the first time, and plans significant AI investments with anticipated 2026 CapEx between $175 billion-$185 billion. Key growth drivers included advancements in AI, increased demand for enterprise AI solutions, strong performance in Search, YouTube subscriptions, and Google Cloud, with the stock rising 0.97% in after-hours trading.

title: Broadcom, Nvidia shares rise on surging Google capital expenditures for AI
summary: Broadcom and Nvidia shares increased after Google announced a significant surge in capital expenditures for artificial intelligence, projecting to spend up to $185 billion this year. This substantial investment is nearly double last year's spending and is expected to benefit companies like Broadcom, which helps manufacture Google's custom tensor processing unit chips (TPUs), and Nvidia, as Google also utilizes their chips for AI development. Analysts believe this increased AI infrastructure spending will positively impact the "Google cohort" of technology companies.

title: Why This Analyst Just Raised Their Price Target on Broadcom Stock
summary: Wolfe Research has upgraded Broadcom (AVGO) to "Outperform" with a $400 price target, citing increasing confidence in Google's TPU program and Broadcom's critical role as a supplier. This upgrade follows Broadcom's stellar Q4 2025 results, which saw record revenue and earnings driven by accelerated AI demand. Despite recent stock volatility, analysts maintain a "Strong Buy" consensus with a mean price target reflecting significant upside potential.

title: Nvidia and Uber Just Announced a Major New Robotaxi Partnership. Does That Make UBER Stock a Buy Here?
summary: Uber (UBER) has partnered with Nvidia (NVDA) and Mercedes (MBGYY) to develop a robotaxi company, leveraging Uber's vast real-life data for AI models. Despite recent Q3 earnings showing strong growth, the stock reacted negatively due to management's announcement that autonomous vehicles will not be profitable for several years. Analysts maintain a "Strong Buy" rating for UBER, projecting significant upside, as future earnings growth and the company's valuable data are expected to drive its stock price higher.

title: Unity stock steadies premarket after Google’s Project Genie shock — what to watch next
summary: Unity Software Inc. shares rebounded modestly in premarket trading after a steep drop caused by Google's Project Genie announcement, which sparked fears that AI-generated interactive worlds could disrupt traditional game engine demand. While Unity's CEO and some analysts downplay the immediate threat, investors are closely watching the company's Q4 and full-year 2025 results on February 11th for clarity on management's AI strategy and growth prospects. The debate continues over how "world model" AI will impact the gaming industry and Unity's valuation.

title: Why This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Is Gaining Attention From Institutional Investors
summary: Alphabet has become a top holding for several prominent hedge funds due to its robust AI technology stack, including custom Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) and the Gemini large language model. The company leverages its distribution and ad network advantages to monetize AI features and maintains a reasonable valuation despite its recent growth.

title: Norway’s $2.2 trillion sovereign wealth fund reduces stakes in top U.S. tech firms (NORW:NYSEARCA)
summary: Norway's $2.2 trillion sovereign wealth fund, Norges Bank Investment Management, decreased its stakes in major U.S. tech companies during the second half of 2025. This reduction included its largest holding, Nvidia, as well as other significant tech firms. The move comes as disclosed in newly released portfolio data.

title: Google stock price today: Alphabet Class C inches up as regulators circle and a $135 million Android settlement lands
summary: Alphabet Inc.'s Class C shares (GOOG) rose slightly as Google agreed to a $135 million settlement for an Android data use lawsuit, while facing new regulatory scrutiny in Europe and Britain regarding its Search and AI services. Investors are also anticipating Alphabet's earnings report on February 4th, amidst high expectations for Big Tech. The company's heavy investment in AI and potential regulatory changes pose both opportunities and risks for its stock performance.

summary: This research report offers an in-depth analysis of Apple Inc. (AAPL) as of January 28, 2026, highlighting its pivot to generative AI, upcoming fiscal first-quarter earnings, and anticipated leadership transition. It concludes that Apple remains a technology fortress but faces critical shifts in strategy, execution, and succession that will define its next 12 months.

title: Broadcom (AVGO): The Architect of the AI Era and the VMware Transformation
summary: Broadcom Inc. has transformed into a dual-engine powerhouse, driving AI infrastructure and enterprise software, largely due to its strategic acquisition of VMware and its critical role in the AI networking stack. The company, led by CEO Hock Tan, reported record-breaking financial results in FY2025, with significant growth in AI-related revenue and strong free cash flow. Despite potential risks like customer concentration and the VMware transition, Broadcom's dominant market position and disciplined management make it a key player in the technology landscape.

title: Strong Analyst Sentiment on Microsoft (MSFT) Despite Price Target Cuts and Heavy AI Spend
summary: Despite recent price target cuts from Barclays and Wells Fargo, Wall Street analysts maintain strong bullish sentiment on Microsoft (MSFT), with 95% recommending a buy. The company continues to strengthen its AI ecosystem through acquisitions like Osmos and strategic partnerships, solidifying its leadership in enterprise AI solutions amidst positive outlooks for the software sector.

title: These Funds Hold the Largest Stakes in Alphabet Stock
summary: Alphabet's stock surge, driven by AI enthusiasm and the release of Gemini 3, has significantly impacted funds heavily invested in the company. The Provident Trust Strategy Fund and Fidelity OTC Portfolio hold the largest stakes, with several ESG-focused funds also appearing on the list of top holders. This performance has propelled Alphabet to become the world's second-largest company, highlighting the strong returns for funds with major allocations to its stock.

title: Here's an AI Stock Nobody's Talking About -- But Should Be
summary: The article highlights InterDigital (NASDAQ: IDCC) as an overlooked AI stock that focuses on intellectual property and foundational technology rather than consumer-facing products. The company develops cutting-edge tech, obtains patents, and licenses its innovations across various industries, including wireless networks and AI video coding. InterDigital's business model has led to significant growth in its patent portfolio, establishing it as a leader in setting global technology standards.

title: Google Shares Jump After Hours on Apple Deal to Integrate Gemini With Siri
summary: Google's parent company, Alphabet Inc. (GOOG), saw its shares jump after Apple announced a deal to integrate Google's Gemini AI into Siri as part of its Apple Intelligence platform. This partnership positions Gemini as a core engine for Siri, potentially boosting Alphabet's valuation and AI revenue growth, despite competitive pressures from OpenAI. The market reacted positively, while some, like Elon Musk, raised concerns about power concentration.

title: Did Benchmark Electronics' (BHE) New AI-Focused CTO Just Reshape Its Technology Investment Narrative?
summary: Benchmark Electronics (BHE) recently appointed Josh Hollin, an AI, robotics, and advanced manufacturing expert, as its new CTO. This appointment is expected to influence the company's technology investments, particularly in advanced computing and AI data center programs. While Hollin's focus aligns with the existing advanced computing recovery thesis, the article notes that investors should be aware of potential headwinds in semi-cap and industrial demand.

title: Apple will use Google’s Gemini models to power new Siri release
summary: Apple Inc. has announced a multi-year partnership with Google LLC to integrate Google's Gemini series of large language models into its Siri voice assistant. The upgraded Siri, part of Apple's new AI suite called Apple Intelligence, is expected to provide more personalized responses and handle multi-step tasks across various apps, rolling out later this year. This collaboration has also reportedly pushed Alphabet Inc.'s market capitalization above $4 trillion, making it the fourth company to reach this milestone.

title: Apple calls on Google to help smarten up Siri and bring other AI features to the iPhone
summary: Apple is partnering with Google to integrate Google's Gemini AI technology into its "Apple Intelligence" suite for the iPhone and other products. This collaboration aims to enhance Siri and other AI features, addressing Apple's previous delays in the AI race. The deal is seen as a significant validation for Google, whose parent company, Alphabet, recently surpassed Apple in market value, driven by its AI advancements.

title: Alphabet hits $4-trillion valuation as AI refocus lifts sentiment
summary: Alphabet briefly reached a $4 trillion market valuation, driven by its intensified focus on artificial intelligence. This surge, which saw its class-A shares hit a record high, reflects growing investor confidence and follows the company surpassing Apple in market capitalization for the first time since 2019. The company's AI efforts, including its Google Cloud unit and the Gemini models, have contributed significantly to its strong performance and market leadership.

title: How Invesco’s AI and Software ETF Evolved to Capture Current Opportunities
summary: Invesco has updated its AI and Next Gen Software ETF (IGPT) to adapt to the evolving software landscape, particularly with the rise of generative AI. The modernization includes changes to the fund's name, ticker, index, and investment strategy, focusing on revenue-driven exposure to current opportunities. The revamped ETF targets three subthemes: AI-powered development platforms, the broader AI ecosystem, and robotics and automation.

summary: This article from Zacks Research Daily presents expert analysis on 16 major stocks, highlighting new research reports on NVIDIA, Alphabet, and Amazon.com, which have shown strong market performance due to advancements in AI, cloud services, and e-commerce. title: Alphabet CEO Pichai Sundar sells $10.4 million in stock By Investing.com
summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai sold 22,411 shares of Class C Capital Stock for $10.4 million on January 7, 2026. The sale occurred when Alphabet's stock was trading near its 52-week high, reflecting a strong market position and "GREAT" financial health according to InvestingPro. Despite the sale, Pichai retains significant holdings in both Class C and Class A shares, while the company continues to advance in AI with features like Gemini in Gmail.

title: Why Alphabet Stock Topped the Market Today
summary: Alphabet's stock rose over 2% today after news that a U.S. House of Representatives subcommittee will discuss proposals to increase autonomous vehicle deployments. The company's Waymo subsidiary is a leader in self-driving technology, making it a direct beneficiary of any relaxed regulations. This move aims to boost the U.S.'s competitiveness in the next-generation auto industry.

title: These Stocks Drove the Market’s Gains in 2025
summary: In 2025, technology and communication-services stocks, particularly those related to AI like Nvidia and Alphabet, significantly fueled market gains, pushing the Morningstar US Market Index up by 17.4%. These sectors accounted for nearly 60% of the market's overall growth. Conversely, consumer defensive and real estate sectors lagged, adding minimal points to the market return due to factors like sluggish consumer spending and tariff impacts.

title: Google stock’s best year since 2009 sets up a tougher 2026 test for Alphabet’s AI spending
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) experienced its best annual stock performance since 2009 in 2025, driven by investor enthusiasm for its AI initiatives. However, Wall Street anticipates a sharp slowdown in 2026 earnings growth as increased capital spending on AI infrastructure puts pressure on Google Cloud to perform and the core search business to adapt. Despite rising investment costs, some investors remain bullish on Alphabet's long-term prospects.

title: Why Are Adobe Shares Sliding On Friday?
summary: Adobe (ADBE) shares are falling on Friday following a downgrade from William Blair analyst Arjun Bhatia due to growing concerns about the software sector and potential AI-driven disruption to traditional SaaS models. The stock is also facing technical headwinds, trading significantly below its moving averages, and is near its 52-week low. Furthermore, Google's Stitch redesign poses a competitive threat, especially after its recent unveiling caused a dip in Adobe shares on March 18.

title: Alphabet Inc. $GOOGL Shares Acquired by Inspirion Wealth Advisors LLC
summary: Inspirion Wealth Advisors LLC significantly increased its stake in Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) by 109.3% in the fourth quarter, reaching a total of 3,817 shares valued at $1.195 million. This coincides with Alphabet's strong Q4 earnings, which surpassed analyst expectations, and a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $367.18. Despite positive AI momentum and analyst upgrades, the company faces near-term challenges from regulatory pressures, a YouTube legal verdict, and technical selling pressure.

title: SLB and Baker Hughes Advance AI-Enabled Power Optimization
summary: SLB and Baker Hughes are partnering with technology giants NVIDIA and Google Cloud, respectively, to develop AI-enabled power optimization and sustainability solutions for the data center sector. SLB's collaboration with NVIDIA focuses on designing and deploying AI infrastructure, modular data center components, and an AI Factory for Energy. Meanwhile, Baker Hughes will work with Google Cloud to leverage AI for optimizing power generation, management, and consumption in data centers, building on its expertise in turbomachinery and power systems.

title: Memory Stocks Slide As Google's New AI Efficiency Breakthrough May Slash Data Storage Needs
summary: Shares of memory and storage companies like SanDisk, Western Digital, and Micron Technology saw declines following Google's announcement of "TurboQuant." This new set of advanced quantization algorithms significantly compresses large language models (LLMs) by reducing key-value memory size by at least 6x without sacrificing accuracy. The breakthrough could lead to reduced data storage needs for AI applications.
